system.description:
The crashing waves of the Daughter's song carry the full force of her own heart. With inspiring verses she lifts listeners to the heights of passion; with melodies of despair she drowns them in black melancholy, sweeping an entire audience along on whatever emotion she chooses.

Sing for a full turn, then make a Social Challenge (retest Performance) against every target within hearing range you choose to affect; Willpower may be used to retest in defense as usual, and if you affect multiple listeners use a mass challenge as in mob combat. Anyone who succumbs is swept up in an overwhelming surge of the emotion your song directs, and must roleplay it for as long as you continue singing and perform no other action. The player need not truly sing to invoke the power, though the talented are encouraged to.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
